← Reading Habit Coach

A home for your reading life

Track books, save reading sessions, capture thoughts and see your habits take shape.

One library, every format

Keep records for physical books, audiobooks, library ebooks and personal documents. Add books manually, search optional Open Library metadata, and organise your shelves.

Make time for a chapter

Start, pause and resume a reading session. Add minutes and page progress manually when you have already read.

Keep the good ideas

A searchable journal for ideas, quotes, questions, summaries and reflections, linked to your books.

Your pace, your progress

Set daily minute and weekly reading-day goals. Confirmed weekly consistency respects days off.
